commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
BRANCH=work/photomap-straighten-20260912
BASE=c06b98517007762997fbb8ed717d74b7b885ada1
SHA=93a5931ad704d80e851693f8c7d520044ddf8684
git fetch origin "$BRANCH"
test "$(git rev-parse origin/$BRANCH)" = "$SHA"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
git switch --detach "$SHA"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$SHA"
git diff --check "$BASE" "$SHA"
VENV=$(mktemp -d /tmp/photomap-async-form-117-XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$VENV"; ./scripts/devctl.sh stop >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT
python3 -m venv "$VENV"
"$VENV/bin/python" -m pip install -q -r backend/requirements.txt
cd frontend
npm run lint
npm run build
npm run test -- src/components/admin/AdminAudioControls.test.tsx src/components/places/MemoryUploadForm.test.tsx src/components/admin/AdminModalForms.test.tsx
PYTHON="$VENV/bin/python" npm run test:e2e -- e2e/visual/public-memory-submit-lock.spec.ts e2e/visual/admin-place-photo-review-lock.spec.ts e2e/visual/admin-media-mutation-lock.spec.ts e2e/visual/admin.spec.ts --project=chromium --grep-invert 'visual:'
cd ..
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
git fetch origin "$BRANCH"
test "$(git rev-parse origin/$BRANCH)" = "$SHA"
printf 'verified_sha=%s\n' "$SHA"
trap - EXIT
rm -rf "$VENV"
./scripts/devctl.sh stop >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
